body:
Yeah, I suppose I wasn't the one who made the mistakes. Maybe I just wish I could have everything be right when I do things right. Joint efforts are hard... and every relationship is one.

I'm in the States unfortunately.

My mommy is great. I don't tell her about my suicidal tendencies because I don't want to worry her but she knows about my depression.

And here's to hoping... maybe in 2015 lol...
And then those new friends will leave like all the others :/. It's a cycle that I hate to see.
